newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher on NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher on NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday as market liquidity tightened following the central bank's issue of negotiable certificates of deposit, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.862 percent against Saturday's 5.679 close -- slightly above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.00 percent against against 5.50-5.55.
The market was closed on Monday for a national holiday.
The central bank issued T$10 billion NCDs on Tuesday.
Dealers said the rates' movement on Wednesday would depend on whether the central bank launches further mop-up measures.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8325 percent against 5.8400.
